name: arra-memory-lab
description: A one-click Cloudflare memory-systems lab with D1, Drizzle, Workers AI, Elysia, React, and MCP

scripts.check: bun test src/*.test.ts && tsc --noEmit && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run build && wrangler deploy

LAB_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Generate a long random bearer token, for example with `openssl rand -hex 32`. The browser keeps it only in session storage; MCP clients send it as an Authorization bearer token.

DB.description: D1 stores authoritative memories, derived chunks, evidence-backed observations, and bounded metadata-only search traces.

AI.description: Workers AI creates 768-dimensional EmbeddingGemma vectors for optional semantic and hybrid recall.
